scope: First .06 slice: reviewed exact-old/new EN corrections and exact-JP glossary proposals, planned together; human drift/force/decoded-flow construction remains separate unfinished work. No .06/family credit from this slice alone.

API.registry_inputs: Exactly glossary/corrections/glossary_proposals, existing {path,size,sha256} pins; all three JSON, paths relative to profile. No registry_updates/import/column/image fields.
API.corrections: Bare array, closed objects with id,old_en,new_en,note_suffix; all strings, id/new_en/note_suffix nonempty, old_en may be empty. Exact fully authored suffix includes separator and historical annotation if desired; no Go-generated term/date boilerplate.
API.glossary_proposals: Bare array, closed objects with jp,en,provenance,source,usage_note; all five nonempty strings. New entry projects exactly those five; unknown/alias/null keys refuse.
API.options: Same --source registryJSON, --recipes, preview and --apply --output newZIP. No new CLI flag/general policy/inline alternative.

normalization: Existing canonical numeric registry IDs for lookup; reject normalized duplicates in existing registry and corrections before keyed collapse. Existing record ID spellings/order preserved. Glossary JP is exact decoded string, no trim/NFC; reject duplicate existing/proposed JP before indexing.
decisions: Validate all authored input types/Unicode/duplicates before planning, including already-present records. Selected current EN must be a paired-Unicode string.
current EN==new_en -> already_applied before old/status handling, with no note append or metadata changes; unknown/null status on such unchanged rows remains untouched.
otherwise current EN!=old_en -> stale fatal, whole pair refuses.
otherwise known locked status patched/decode_verified/emulator_confirmed -> held, no EN/note mutation, glossary proposals may still advance.
otherwise only known drafted/zone_pending may change EN via existing owner; unknown/null/missing/wrong-type status on actual change refuses.

On actual EN change, missing/null current note means empty; a present other value must be a paired-Unicode string. Append exact note_suffix without trimming/newline normalization; no second append on replay.

Existing same JP/EN glossary entry preserves ALL provenance/metadata. Different EN conflicts fatally. New proposals append in authored order; selected existing JP/EN string and Unicode validation is explicit.
idempotence: NEW Go behavior, not historical parity: unchanged member preserves exact source bytes/date, including held-only registry while glossary advances. Changed member uses shared readable serializer and explicit updated date. All-present pair has two exact source members and deterministic archive. Original source always rewrote both dates; keep observations distinct.

limits.qualification: Explicit finite new bounds, not actual cohort inventory or generic hostile-memory sandbox. Shared conservative two-space preflight may overcount empty containers.

publication: Prepare all outcomes and both member buffers, then fixed-name/order ZIP registry.json,glossary.json using zip.Store/deterministic headers and close central directory. Recheck original registry handle/hash, all named pinned inputs and raw profile bytes before one existing writeNewFile call. ZIP output is a complete verified artifact on successful return, NOT atomic pathname visibility or installation of two canonical files. No source/canonical file is overwritten. Existing output refusal and owned-inode cleanup retained.
reuse: Existing authorRegistry contiguous pair preflight, ready EN/note through existing mutation path, shared ordered one-or-two-document serialization loop, existing checkJSON/glyph-independent JSON validation/bounded input/writeNewFile, standard ZIP pattern from manifestTextures/contactSheets. No new function/helper/closure or per-script handler. Revisit pure boundary if unrelated branches/mode bags would be required.
type_plan: Correction/proposal transport fields differ from canonical RegistryEntry. Inspect RegistryEntry and existing types; place unavoidable intent/value structs in registry_types.go grouped by usage. No new public Recipes field is needed. One transient document record may replace parallel source/member arrays in shared serialization.
profile_recheck: Extend existing RegistryOptions with raw profile path for paired operation and pass existing recipe path from main.run; require bounded byte-identity recheck before publication. Do not add another loader/parser or expand old unrelated behavior speculatively.
verification: Independent new pair/member goldens BEFORE Go edits, not direct blind reuse of20source observations. Preview/guardedZIP/apply/replay/normalizedalias/typedrefusals/suffixUnicodeCRLF/rawnumbers/deepbudgets/immutableinputs. Existing actualCLI test owner and all old4policy/import/status/export/author/machine routes unchanged; core/actualnativefonts buildvet/focused/race/freshreview/accounting before acceptance.
design_preference: User optional ZIP-vs-directory question unanswered after reasonable opportunity; root announces recommended ZIP assumption within already-authorized migration. Not user approval; do not implement both modes.
result_count_delta: RPR-1: complete result must satisfy the same65536entry consuming-reader limit. Existing-lookup no-op at capacity stays allowed; absent-JP append refuses at capacity.
